title: The nimshal: Yachid, Echad, Kadmon in the Essence, and a fourth level after the tzimtzum
overview: Chapter 11 is the *nimshal* of chapter 10, "almost a repetition of it": the three levels traced in the soul are now traced in the Essence of the *Or Ein Sof* before the *tzimtzum*. In *Yachid* the ten *sefiros* are hidden in the Essence itself, every attribute infinite, down to kingship and *Ana Emloch*. The whole *hishtalshelus* arose only because He is kind, and to Him it is one little *prat*, like scratching your ear while you talk; only the study of *Chassidus* reminds Him what He wanted it for. In *Echad* the powers seem to come out and stay one. In *Kadmon* the exact *shiur* is ready down to the end of *Asiya*, made the way a cat jumps: by looking at the mouse, not at the jump. Then a fourth level: the *reshimu* and the *Kav*, contracted and still a level of the Essence. Here the sandwich shows what *hafshatas hagashmiyus* really means: the physical act comes from the *Aibershter*, not from the will. The chapter ends by reading the levels into "Blessed is He who spoke".

sections.title: Yachid: the ten sefiros hidden in the concealment of the Essence itself
sections.summary: Chapter 11 is the *nimshal* of chapter 10: the three levels shown in the soul are now traced above, in the Essence of the *Or Ein Sof* before the *tzimtzum*, starting with *Yachid*, where the ten *sefiros* are hidden in the Essence itself. This is not what the Rebbe Rashab's *Ayin Beis* is about.

phrases.he: (יא) והנמשל מכל הנזכר לעיל בנפש
יובן למשכיל
למעלה בעצמות אור אין סוף שלפני הצמצום
שנקרא יחיד
וכלול גם שם מעשר ספירות,
phrases.en: So over there it also includes in it ten *sefiros*,

phrases.he: ונקרא עשר ספירות הגנוזות בהעלם העצמות ממש

blocks.text: Chapter 11 is the *nimshal* of chapter 10. The three levels shown there in the soul (the *etzem* (essence) of the light, the light ready for *hispashtus* (spreading forth), and ready for it in an actual *prat* (particular) outside) are now shown above, in the Essence of the *Or Ein Sof* before the *tzimtzum*, called *Yachid*.
The long definition is deliberate: the *sefiros* in *Adam Kadmon* are also called hidden. These are hidden in the concealment of the Essence itself.

blocks.question: The Rebbe Rashab seems to put the ten hidden sefiros in Kadmon. Is it the same thing?
blocks.text: The Rashab speaks not of *Yachid*, nor even of *Kadmon*, which is only a possible *hispashtus*. Here all three levels, *Kadmon* included, are in the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*; *Ayin Beis* (the Rashab's discourses) is about the light's *hispashtus* after *Kadmon*: *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Kadmon*.

Reb Hillel Paritcher said there are two levels in the *Atzmus*, "He" and "He alone", and two in the light, its *etzem* and its *hispashtus*. All this, *Kadmon* included, is the *etzem*: measured for spreading, not spreading yet. What the Rashab gives a hundred chapters is here between the lines.

The Rashab's subject comes after: once the light is *mamash* (actually) ready to spread at the end of *Kadmon* and still does not, held back, like the life ready to go out to the body. It is easy to confuse the two without knowing what each is about.

If that is a hundred chapters, the Rashab's chapter 10 would be a thousand. All of *Ayin Beis* is on the first few chapters of this book, and not all of them. Still, it is not a different approach: the Rashab treats a different matter within the *tzimtzum*.

blocks.title: The schools of Kabbala do not disagree
blocks.text: A *maamar* (discourse) of the Rebbe, from *yud-daled* or *yud-zayin*, says the Rashab does not disagree with the Mitteler Rebbe. Even the Ramak and the Arizal give views of one thing, not disputes; the Rashab does not even give another view. He explains a different matter in *hishtalshelus*, and says so.

By the time the Rashab finished, these 78 pages would be ten thousand chapters. Here *yichuda tata'a* (the lower unity) gets about two chapters, mostly in *Malchus* of *Atzilus*; one covers *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, one or two the *galgalim* (celestial orbits) and constellations, the last the *kelipos* (lit. husks). This book covers everything; *Ayin Beis* assumes the framework.

sections.title: The desire for kindness: why there is a world at all, and why to Him it is a fidget
sections.summary: The simple will for the whole *hishtalshelus* arose only because He is kind in Himself, and to Him the whole chain is one little particular, like scratching your ear while you talk; the study of *Chassidus* is the exception. Every particular kindness is already in the *hiyuli* desire for kindness, made of ten, without even unity.

phrases.he: כמו בחינת חפץ חסד
שכלול בבחינת עצמיות דאור אין סוף,
שמחמתו וסיבתו היה הרצון הפשוט לכל ההשתלשלות,
phrases.en: Because of this *chafetz chesed*, this is what caused the original *ratzon hapashut* for all *hishtalshelus*.

phrases.he: שזהו בדבר פרט
phrases.en: That this whole *hishtalshelus*, in terms of the *Aibershter*, is considered just one little *prat*.

blocks.text: This *chafetz chesed* in the Essence caused the *ratzon hapashut* (simple will) for all of *hishtalshelus*, which to the *Aibershter* (the One Above) is one little *prat*, not what He is into.

blocks.title: Fidgeting with your ear
blocks.text:
One place gives a *mashal* (analogy) for what is less than a *prat*. While we talk, you fidget your foot or scratch your neck. It comes from you: if you didn't do it, it wouldn't happen. Yet you are so into the talking that you *mamash* don't realize it.

Ask someone who always plays with his ear why, and he says he didn't even realize. How not? His brain had to send the message through the nerves to his hand.
So on Rosh Hashana, with the remembrances, we remind the *Aibershter* of the *Malchus* (kingship), that He is there: He is off into His thing.
"He's busy learning *Shaar HaYichud*."
Meanwhile this whole world is just like a *prat*.

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב בעץ חיים בהקדמה,
כשעלה ברצונו הפשוט כו'
ובודאי סיבת עליית הרצון הפשוט בעצמותו
היינו רק כי חפץ חסד הוא בעצמו
על כן עלה ברצונו להטיב חסדו
phrases.en: That's why He decided to do a good thing.

phrases.he: להיות מקור למקור להשתלשלות דקו וחוט כו'

blocks.text: The simple will arose only because He is kind in Himself, as a kind man does a kindness because he is kind. So He decided to do good, to be a source of the source.

The world is an insignificant *prat*, but not the study of *Chassidus* (Chassidic teaching): that is the *etzem*, what He was into, and it reminds Him, "Oh, that's right, that's what I wanted the whole world for."

blocks.question: What does makor l'makor, a source of the source, mean?
blocks.text: He is not actually a source, nor a source of a source, but you have to say something: like the *Mekora d'Kula* (the Source of everything) in the last chapter, He is no source, yet it came from Him. So we say "source of the source", twice and not five times, knowing it is not even that.

phrases.he: והרי זה על דרך דוגמא
כשמחמת עצמיות המדה דחפץ חסד הכלולה בבחינת יחידה כנזכר לעיל,
עולה ברצונו לעשות טוב וחסד בדבר פרט כנזכר לעיל
שבא בגלוי מן העלמו ההיולי דחפץ חסד,
phrases.en: that comes from the hidden *chafetz chesed*:

phrases.he: לכלול כל מה שיעלה בפרט ברצונו להטיב
phrases.en: anything that he will have a *ratzon* to do good was already included.

phrases.he: הכל בא מחמתו וכחו כו'
phrases.en: Everything comes because of the power of the *hiyuli* of *chafetz chesed*.

blocks.text: For example, the *chafetz chesed* in a man's *yechida* makes him want to give someone a sandwich. That comes out of the hidden *chafetz chesed*, its *hiyuli* (raw potential), which already held every good he will ever want to do.

phrases.he: וכמו שבגלוי רצון שבא מחמת חפץ חסד זה,
כלול מי', חב''ד ומדות כו'
מזה מוכרח שגם בבחינת חפץ חסד ההיולי שכלול בעצמות ממש,
כלול מי', חכמה ומדות כו'
רק שלא יתכן בהם לומר גם ענין ההתכללות והאחדות,
אחר שכלול בעצמות בבחינת היולי עדיין כו'

blocks.text: As the revealed will is made of ten, *Chabad* and *middos*, so is the *hiyuli* in the Essence; only there one cannot even speak of inclusion and unity.
This chapter can be learned fast: it says exactly what the last one said in the *mashal*, in a person, now in the *nimshal*.

sections.title: Every attribute alike, down to kingship and Ana Emloch
sections.summary: *Gevura*, *netzach*, *tiferes* and every other attribute, down to the kingship of the *Ein Sof*, are infinite and made of ten in the Essence. Even *Ana Emloch*, the thought of kingship coming into a particular, is wholly included in *Yachid*.

phrases.he: וכמו כן במדה זולתה,
כמו מדת הגבורה או הנצח והתפארת וכהאי גוונא
הכל הוא כלול בעצמיות דאור אין סוף שנקרא טהירו עילאה
והוא הנקרא יחיד שלמעלה מאחד פשוט כו'

blocks.text: So every other attribute, *gevura*, *netzach*, *tiferes*, is in the Essence, the *tehiru ila'a*: *Yachid*, above simple One.

phrases.he: עד בחינת מדת המלוכה
בעצמות אור אין סוף
שנקרא מלכות דאין סוף
גם הוא כלול בבחינת היולי העצמי דעצמות אור אין סוף
שהוא בבחינת אין סוף ממש
וכמו שחפץ חסד בבחינת אין סוף ממש בעצמות,
או לחכמתו אין סוף,
כך מדת ההתנשאות
שכלול בעצמות אור אין סוף
הוא בבחינת אין סוף
וכלול מי' בהעלם העצמות,
שהוא בחינת הרצון והתענוג וחכמה ומדות שבמדות המלוכה

blocks.text: So too the attribute of kingship, here *Malchus* of *Yachid*: it is in the essential *hiyuli*, infinite like *chafetz chesed*, *mamash* as the last chapter said, and made of ten as well.

phrases.he: אך
phrases.en: However,

phrases.he: ענין אנא אמלוך שעלה ברצונו ומחשבתו הפשוט, היינו כשבא בדבר פרט, לבחינת ההשתלשלות בגלוי מהעלמו ההיולי
phrases.en: This thing of *Ana Emloch* means that He had a *machshava* to have it in a revelation from the *hiyuli*.

phrases.he: כנזכר לעיל במדה דחפץ חסד באדם למטה,
phrases.en: Like we said in the last chapter, that in the *midda* of *chafetz chesed* there, there was the thing of doing the *chesed* to somebody else.

phrases.he: וכנזכר לעיל במשל י' כחות הכלולים שבבחינת יחידה,
בבחינת היולי ועצמיות כו'

blocks.text: *Ana Emloch*, arising in His simple will and thought, is a thought to bring it into a particular, *hishtalshelus*, revealed out of the *hiyuli*.
As *chafetz chesed* in man includes doing the kindness, which means to somebody else, so does *Malchus*; and as with the ten powers in the *yechida*.

phrases.he: שאינן נבדלים מן העצם כלל
וכמו כח התנועה שכלול בעצם החי,
וכהתפשטות החיות ההיולי הכלול בעצם הנפש ממש כנזכר לעיל

blocks.text: The powers are not separate from the essence, like motion in a living being. The *Ana Emloch* too, though in a particular, is included: that is *Yachid*.

sections.title: Echad: a spreading forth still inside Himself, unified and simple
sections.summary: *Echad* is the light that spreads forth, but inside the Essence, before the *tzimtzum*: powers seem to separate out and do not. Unity can be spoken of there, unlike in *Yachid*, yet it is still the ten *sefiros* *bli ma* and simple unity.

phrases.he: ולמטה מזה
הוא בחינת אור אין סוף המאיר ומתפשט
והכל עדיין בבחינת עצמותו לפני הצמצום
phrases.en: So, in other words, this is still in the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*.

phrases.he: וזהו הנקרא אחדות הפשוטה

blocks.text: Below this is *Echad*, *achdus hapshuta*: the *Or Ein Sof* shining and spreading, still in His Essence before the *tzimtzum*. It spreads inside Himself, as the *hiyuli* for the spreading.

In names, so to speak: *Echad* is *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Yachid*, and *Kadmon* *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Echad*. Chapter 7's rule, that the lower's *Malchus* becomes the upper's *Keser* (crown), here runs downward: the upper's *Malchus* becomes the lower's *Keser*.
At *Echad* one can say the powers came out, as if separating, though they do not really separate: this is *achdus hapshuta*.

phrases.he: שיתכן שם בחינת התכללות ואחדות בעשר ספירות
וגם הם נקרא עשר ספירות בלי מה,
כי הוא למעלה גם מבחינת הכנה להשפעה למטה בגלוי עדיין
phrases.en: It's still not really even prepared for *hashpa'a* downstairs, to revelation.

phrases.he: רק שמוכן לצאת מההיולי בדבר פרט

blocks.text: There one can speak of division and unity in the ten *sefiros*, yet they are still *bli ma*, not actual *sefiros*, above any readiness to give below.
It is only ready to come out of the *hiyuli*; we say so because it did come out.

phrases.he: כמו חפץ חסד ההיולי הנזכר לעיל,
כשבא לענין הרצון וחפץ חסד בהשתלשלות דקו כו'
גם שלא יצא עדיין בגלוי גמור, גם בעצמו,
phrases.en: Meaning, he doesn't even know yet what it is.

phrases.he: על כל פנים שם יתכן בחינת אחדות והתכללות
phrases.en: There you could say it's unification of powers.

phrases.he: רק שנקרא אחדות הפשוטה בהיותו עדיין באור עצמותו
הפשוט בתכלית
phrases.en: It's totally *pashut*.

blocks.text: Like *chafetz chesed* turning to the will for *hishtalshelus*, unrevealed even to itself: He doesn't yet know what it is. Still, there one can speak of a unification of powers.

blocks.title: When somebody else grabs the bottle
blocks.text: Yet they are *mamash* one, as in *Kadmon*: when somebody else grabs the bottle of vodka, motion becomes speech. Up there it is the same power.
In *Yachid* there are no powers to call unity; *Echad* is simple unity, still in His simple Essence.

phrases.he: וכמו בחינת התחלקות שכל ומדות כו' שבחפץ חסד זה,
שמחמתו הוא שעלה ברצונו וחכמתו להטיב כו'
גם טרם בואו לגלוי כלל וכלל כו',
phrases.en: Even before it came into an actual revelation.

phrases.he: וכנזכר לעיל במדריגה הב' בנפש האדם.
phrases.en: Like we explained in chapter 10.

blocks.text: So the division into intellect and *middos* is there before any revelation, like the second level in the soul in chapter 10.

sections.title: Kadmon: the whole shiur is ready, and it is made by looking at the mouse
sections.summary: In *Kadmon* the exact *shiur* of the influence, down to the end of *Asiya*, is ready, as the power of motion is ready with the whole movement and still has not moved. But the *shiur* is made by looking at the goal, as the cat looks only at the mouse: that is the *glif glifu*, *Malchus* of *Kadmon*.

phrases.he: והג' כאשר מבחינת חפץ חסד זה הוא שעלה כבר ברצון ושכל כו'
והוכן בכל השיעור באותיות ששיער בעצמו
איך יהיה איכות אופן ההשפעה ממש לחוץ מעצמותו
על דרך דוגמא מכח התנועה
המוכן איך להניע
phrases.en: In other words, it's already completely *muchan*, exactly how to grab the bottle.

blocks.text: The third level is measured out, how the influence will go outside His Essence, like the power of motion ready exactly how to grab the bottle.

Somebody told Rabbi Markel the class makes up *meshalim* not in the book, like the cat or the bottle of vodka. But the *mashal* is straight from the book: it says exactly that the power of motion is totally ready for the actual motion, to its end.

So with the cat about to pounce on a mouse: the book says the power of motion of an animal, ready how to move, to the end of the influence outside His Essence, the end of the *Kav*, as he says in various places.

phrases.he: וכח החיות המוכן איך להחיות
כשמוכנים כבר בשיעור ואופן מוגבל,
כנזכר לעיל בענין מדריגה הג' בנפש
phrases.en: Like we said in chapter 10.

blocks.text: In *Echad* it is only ready to have the powers; in *Kadmon* the motion itself is *mamash* ready, to the end, in a limited measure, yet not separate from the power of motion. There is no movement yet.

Even *Kadmon* is still simple unity: when somebody else grabbed the bottle, motion turned into speech, and it could change again. It still changes from one to the other, as with the third level in the soul in chapter 10.

phrases.he: ולמעלה,
phrases.en: And upstairs, in the *nimshal*:

phrases.he: היינו מה ששיער בעצמות אור אין סוף שנקרא טהירו עילאה באופן ושיעור מה שרוצה בהשתלשלות בפועל התגלות דקו עד סוף עולם העשיה
phrases.en: *Mamash* He was *mesha'er* in *Kadmon*, which means in *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*, all the way down to here.

phrases.he: שזהו מה שכתוב גליף גליפו בטהירו עילאה
phrases.en: This is what is said: *glif glifu b'tehiru ila'a*,

phrases.he: כנזכר לעיל
והוא הנקרא בחינת קדמון,
phrases.en: Now he's calling the *glif glifu* *Kadmon*.

phrases.he: דהיינו מה שקדם אופן הרצון להשפיע טרם שמשפיע עדיין בגלוי ממש
וזהו עדיין לפני הצמצום הראשון הנקרא מקום פנוי וחלל כו'
כנ"ל וד"ל.

blocks.text: Above: in *Kadmon*, the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof*, He measured the manner and measure of all *hishtalshelus*, to the end of *Asiya*.

He measured the whole movement, but its point is the bottle or the mouse. So in making the *shiur* (measure) he thinks only of the mouse, and the *shiur* comes up by itself, since it was there all along.

blocks.title: The cat does not take out a ruler
blocks.text:
As a listener put it, any movement is in the power of motion, and the specific one just comes out. The cat does not figure the vector of the jump or get out a ruler to measure the distance to the mouse.

It is a *shiur* of several powers, sight too: the two eyes make a triangle with the bottle to find the depth and how far to reach. Yet you don't think about the *shiur* at all; it is secondary.
So with the *tzimtzum*: what matters is the end of the action. A cat moves his muscles to get the jump right, but his whole focus is on the mouse.

blocks.title: The pitcher
blocks.text: Like a pitcher in baseball: he focuses on where the ball should go. Thinking about how to move his hand would totally mess him up.

blocks.title: Missing the basket
blocks.text: From *Reader's Digest*: a man teaches basketball players, and people making decisions in their lives, that thinking of how rather than of the goal is what screws you up: you miss the basket. "If you think of the *shiur* rather than the mouse, you won't get the mouse." The Eastern martial arts call it a loss of self, though it isn't: think of how, and you lose the spontaneity, and the *shiur* comes out wrong.
(The next tape picks up here.) The player thinks only of where the ball should end up. So He thinks of the end, not of the *shiur*.
blocks.outOfPlace: Opens class 006, finishing the analogy with which class 005 ended, before the lines are reread.

blocks.text: Reading on: the *glif glifu* in the *tehiru ila'a* is *Kadmon*. Before, he put it in *Yachid*, the *tehiru ila'a*; but that includes *Kadmon*, and the real *glif glifu* is *davka* (precisely) in *Kadmon*.

*Glif glifu* is a total will, later called the *ratzon hamuchlat* (absolute will). It belongs to the simple will, beside the simple will itself; the composite will has the general and the particular. That is *Kadmon*.

The very real *glif glifu* is *Malchus* of *Kadmon*: the final letters defining the movement, to the end of the line, once the *shiur* is made. That is before any revelation, before the first *tzimtzum*, the *makom panui* and the void. And that recaps chapter 10.

sections.title: The fourth level: the Kav after the tzimtzum, and who really gives the sandwich
sections.summary: What comes after the *tzimtzum*, the *reshimu* and the *Kav* down to *Asiya*, is still called a level of the Essence, though contracted, as the body's motion is to the soul. The physical act does not come from the spiritual will; it comes from the *Aibershter*, which is what *hafshatas hagashmiyus* really means.

phrases.he: ומדריג' הד' הוא מה שאחר הצמצום הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: So the fourth *madreiga* is the actual world after the *tzimtzum*.

phrases.he: נשאר בחינת הרשימו ונמשך ממנו הקו
שהוא בכללות בחינת טהירו תתאה, בחינת מקיף כללי לכל השתלשלות דקו כו'
phrases.en: And that's the *tehiru tata'a*, which is the *makif klali* for the whole *hishtalshelus* of the *Kav*.

phrases.he: שזהו הבא בבחינת השפעה למטה מן העצמות,

blocks.question: A fourth level? He only told us about three.
blocks.text: He is adding what he spoke of before: the man of kindness giving an actual thing. It is past even the *tehiru tata'a*, which is only the *machshava kduma* (primordial thought): the kindness causing the actual act.

It is the *reshimu* left after the *tzimtzum*, from which the *Kav* is drawn: the actual world after the *tzimtzum*. And he calls it the fourth level of the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof* itself, after *Yachid*, *Echad* and *Kadmon*, not another thing.
This is the beginning of the *Kav*, the *kav hamida* (line of measure), with the *machshava kduma*: the *tehiru tata'a*, encompassing the whole *hishtalshelus* of the *Kav*.
It comes as influence below the Essence; yet all of it, down to *Asiya*, is *mamash* the fourth level of the *Atzmus*, not a separate thing.

blocks.question: You just said that it is part of the Atzmus, but he says here that it "comes as influence below the Essence"?
blocks.text: Below the Essence as it is before the *tzimtzum*. There is no real below the Essence.
blocks.outOfPlace: Asked after the reading of lines 48-53, about line 47.

phrases.he: כמשל חיות המתפשט בגלוי להחיות כו'
phrases.en: Like how it comes into the body, where it's considered the life of the body, which is like a separate thing.

phrases.he: וככח התנועה שמתפשטת להניע הנפעל בגלוי כו'
שמשתנה ממהות רוחני למהות הגשמה כנזכר לעיל
וכמו צמיחה גשמית מצמיחה רוחנית
phrases.en: The actual plant, that comes from *tzemicha ruchanis*, which is just the *hiyuli* in the ground.

phrases.he: כך הוא ערך האור שאחר הצמצום
לגבי האור העצמי שלפני הצמצום
דמשום זה הוצרך להיות ענין הצמצום הזה,
רק בשביל שיוכל להיות הארת האור שבקו,
שבא בשביל מקור לאבי''ע כידוע

blocks.text: As the soul's life spreads into the body and counts as the body's life, as if separate, though it is not really.

blocks.title: An electric current in the arm
blocks.text: The motion in your arm is electric impulses, not your soul: run a current through your arm and the muscle moves without your wanting it.
It changes from spiritual to physical, like the plant from the *hiyuli* in the ground, where nothing really grows. So the light after the *tzimtzum* is *mamash* contracted.
As motion is to the brain, or an idea to the power of intellect, which is no idea at all. The *tzimtzum* was only so the light could shine in the *Kav* as a source for the worlds.

phrases.he: אך עם כל זה
phrases.en: But nonetheless,

phrases.he: הרי כל פרטי העשר ספירות דאבי''ע,
phrases.en: all the *pratim*, all the way to the end of *Asiya*,

phrases.he: הכל כלולים מתחלה בעצמות אור אין סוף
בבחינת היולי ועצמי
ואחר כך על ידי הצמצום
משתנה לפי אופן מוגבל
בהשפעה הכללית דקו בבחינת סובב

blocks.text: **But nonetheless**, every particular, to the end of *Asiya*, is first in the Essence as *hiyuli*, or where would it come from? The *tzimtzum* limits it into the influence of the *Kav*.
Back to *hafshatas hagashmiyus* (stripping away the physical): the physical is a *tzimtzum*, less than the thing itself, and the spiritual does not actually cause it.

blocks.title: Who really gives the sandwich
blocks.text: We say a person's kindness causes him to give the sandwich. Not really: it causes only the will to give. The *Aibershter* moves his body and gave him the money; without it he would be the poor person.

blocks.title: I ain't got that kind of money
blocks.text: He doesn't even know how to move his arm, and the money was the *Aibershter*'s gift; he only wanted to give. Another says, "I'd like to help a lot of people, but I ain't got that kind of money," though his will for kindness could be as strong, maybe stronger.

The real *hafshatas hagashmiyus* is the opposite of what people think when they say to forget the physical for the spiritual. The physical act does not come from the soul's kindness; only the will does. "In the way a man wants to go, he is led": you decide, and the *Aibershter* moves your body.

That makes a sin terrible and a mitzva wonderful. Decide on a sin and you force the *Aibershter* to help, like taking "the king's head and putting it in the toilet" (*Tanya*). Decide on tefillin and you give Him a *dira b'tachtonim*: He gets to put on tefillin.

You take the *mashal* for the *nimshal*, but the *mashal* is physical: only the wish to give came from the soul's kindness. *Hafshatas hagashmiyus* means that by the *Aibershter* it is not so: the sandwich itself came from Him.

People have it backwards, as with saying there is no *chachma* above: there is a whole bunch of *chachma* up there, "the *Aibershter* is super, super, super smart," only so total a *hiyuli* you can't call it *chachma*. Through the *tzimtzum* it comes down into the *Kav*.

phrases.he: והרי זה כדוגמת חיות הנפש הרוחנית כשבאה להחיות הגוף
שכלולה ברוחניות מכל פרטי חיות הגשמיות, ראיה ושמיעה שבגוף הגשמי
כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: Like we explain in chapter 10.

phrases.he: (וענין הצמצום והרשימה יתבאר בסמוך)

blocks.text: As the soul's life gives the body sight and hearing, all included in it spiritually (chapter 10). The *tzimtzum* and the *reshimu* come shortly.

sections.title: "Blessed is He who spoke": the levels in the words of the prayer
sections.summary: The words of *Baruch She'amar* name the levels: "spoke" is the hidden will in *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof*, "and the world came to be" is the *shiur* of *Kadmon* and the *Kav*, "says and does" is what is drawn into the *Kav*, down to *Adam Kadmon* and the *kav hamida*. The point is to tie chapters 10 and 11 to the intentions of prayer.

phrases.he: (וזהו פירוש כללי למה שכתוב ברוך שאמר והיה העולם
פירוש שאמר בהעלם,
ברצונו הפשוט שבמלכות דאין סוף,
בהיותו עדיין כלול בחפץ חסד העצמי הנזכר לעיל
ואחר כך והיה,
בגלוי אור המתפשט לדבר פרט להשתלשלות,
להיות מקור לכל העולמות
ופירוש והיה העולם,
היינו דווקא מן מה ששיער בעצמו בכח
שהוא שרש מה שמתהווה
אחר כך העולם הכללי
phrases.en: Means the general worlds,

phrases.he: שנמשך מן הקו
וכו' וכנזכר לעיל ודי למבין.

blocks.text: This explains "Blessed is He who spoke, and the world came to be": "spoke" in concealment, in the simple will of *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*, still in *chafetz chesed*; "came to be" revealed into *hishtalshelus*, the general worlds drawn from the *Kav*. *Adam Kadmon* is the Adam of *Beriya*.

phrases.he: וברוך הוא, נסתר,
היינו בחינת קדמונו של עולם
דהיינו מה ששיער בעצמו בכח כו'
וכמו שכתוב מגיד מראשית אחרית,
מראשית הקו עד סופו כו'
phrases.en: from the beginning of the *Kav* till the end of the *Kav*.

phrases.he: ומקדם אשר לא נעשה עדיין
phrases.en: *Kedem* means even before the *tzimtzum* He tells what wasn't even made yet.

phrases.he: היינו מקדמונו של עולם הנזכר לעיל
ונקרא ימי קדם, שקודם למה שנמשך בקו
phrases.en: *Yemei kedem* means the *middos* in *Kadmon*, before it even came into the *Kav*.

phrases.he: והוא מה שקדם בעצמו בכח, מה שעתיד להיות בפועל כו' ודי למבין.

blocks.text: "And blessed is He": "He" is hidden, the *Kadmon* of the world. "He tells the end from the beginning": **from the beginning of the** *Kav* till its end.
"And from before": even before the *tzimtzum* He knew what would be made. These are *yemei kedem*: here, though not always elsewhere, the *middos* in *Kadmon*, the *glif glifu* where the *shiur* is.

phrases.he: ומה שכתוב ברוך אומר ועושה כו',
phrases.en: He says, and He did it.

phrases.he: היינו מה שנמשך בקו בפועל ממש
ועושה בראשית כו',
הוא כל שיעור קומת אדם קדמון כו'

blocks.text: "Who says and does" is what is drawn into the *Kav*; "the work of creation", the whole *shiur koma* of *Adam Kadmon*.

For us the work of creation is *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* coming out of *Malchus* of *Atzilus*, and *Atzilus* is the work of the chariot. But to the *Aibershter*, *Atzilus* is the end of *Asiya*, and *Asiya* is already in *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: וגוזר ומקיים, בתחלה,
הוא בחינת קו המדה שלפני אדם קדמון
שהוא בחינת צמצום דרשימו שנמשך ממנו הקו כידוע,
וכמו שיתבאר בעזרת השם בסמוך):

blocks.text: "Decrees" is the *kav hamida* before *Adam Kadmon*, the *tzimtzum* of the *reshimu* from which the *Kav* is drawn. This teaching ties chapters 10 and 11 to the *kavanos* (intentions) in *davenen* (prayer).

reviewQuestions.question: Why is the whole *hishtalshelus* to Him only a *prat*, like fidgeting with your ear, and why is the study of *Chassidus* the exception?
Why does one say *makor l'makor* rather than simply that He is the source?
In which of *Yachid*, *Echad* and *Kadmon* can one speak of unity, and why is it still called simple unity?
What does the cat pouncing on the mouse show about how the *shiur* of *Kadmon* is made?
Why is what comes after the *tzimtzum* called the fourth level of the Essence, and what does "below the Essence" mean?
In what way do people have *hafshatas hagashmiyus* backwards, and what does the sandwich show?

notes.text: Class 005 reads line 1 with "בעצם" for "בנפש" and line 40 with "יחיד לעילא" for "טהירו עילאה"; class 006 rereads lines 40-41 in a different wording ("מה שנתבאר בעצמותו שאינו נתפס... שיעור ממש הרשום בהשתלשלות"). The transcript may be mishearing; the phrases follow the chapter text.

The discussion of the Rebbe Rashab (005 w142-1014) has no speaker labels and student and teacher alternate quickly; the blocks give the content without always saying who said which sentence. "A maamar of the Rebbe, either in yud-daled or yud-zayin" is left as he said it: it is not clear whether he means years (5714, 5717) or volumes.
"These 78 pages" is presumably Shaar HaYichud as printed in his edition.

The pitcher and the Reader's Digest story (005 w3829-4103) pass between two speakers with no labels. The voice that says it read the Reader's Digest piece (w3885-3955) runs on without a break into w4007-4103, which is in Rabbi Markel's own vocabulary ("if you think of the shiur rather than the mouse", "not really a loss of self"), so it is probably he who read it; the story block keeps the hedge "one of them". A listener should decide.
The phone-and-brother joke (005 w1407-1416) is its own aside, flagged private; it also suggests the class is held over the phone with his brother.
In line 23 he points out a typo in his printed text ("the yud is connected to the mashal"); he does not say what it should read. Not checked against the chapter file, which reads "במשל י' כחות".
He reads line 29 with "התחלקות" (division) for "התכללות" (inclusion); the block follows his reading, the phrase follows the text.
The vodka analogy (somebody else grabs the bottle, the power of motion becomes a power of speech) is from the class on chapter 10; here it is only referred to.
Class 006 has Sofer times, not re-timed ones; the seconds of its blocks may be off.
"Adam Kadmon is Adam of Beriya" (006 w2001-2014, w2175-2185) is reported as he said it, "like you said", referring to an earlier remark of the student.
"The king's head in the toilet" is his citation of the Tanya's image for a sin; kept as said, not flagged, since it is the Tanya's own.
Lines 48-53 are read straight through (006 w726-780) and then explained after a question about line 47 (w781-853); the question is placed under line 47 with outOfPlace.
